gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Casual handwriting from Lumanosimo leads, loose and pen-drawn, while Stint Ultra Expanded sets a text serif beneath it, each character floating apart. That gap is the pair's whole charm.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-syncopate: Syncopate draws its sans-serif letters with a technical pen's steadiness, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder. Over a longer passage it moves in a measured, tidy rhythm, while the wiry handwriting of Lumanosimo above keeps things from feeling stiff.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-manrope: Loose handwriting meets bright, open curves. Lumanosimo gives the top a pen-drawn ease, and Manrope backs it with a plain sans whose rounded letters stay tidy and lower in height.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-montserrat: Wire-thin, pen-and-paper strokes mark Lumanosimo. It earns its keep big and brief, with Montserrat's sans-serif lines gliding along underneath, taller in the lowercase and full of generous white space.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-satoshi: Graceful handwriting from Lumanosimo sits over Satoshi, whose soaring x-height and wide-open e look confident and friendly. One is a casual hand; the other, a crisp sans.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-switzer: Switzer brings tubular, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line, so the plain sans looks upright and orderly. Switzer then carries a longer stretch of text smoothly, its c tips never crowding, while Lumanosimo adds the hand-drawn flourish.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-work-sans: Strokes as thin as a drawn wire give Lumanosimo its casual, pen-and-paper look. And Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line and open c tips, keeps a longer stretch of text steady and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-luxurious-roman-gf-bhutuka-expand: Open terminals make Luxurious Roman easy to read even at its boldest, and it earns its keep big and short. But BhuTuka Expanded One follows with curvy, unclamped letters of flat weight and a classic serif's literary air.
gen-gf-luxurious-roman-gf-hepta-slab: Luxurious Roman is bold, expressive display type with open terminals. Hepta Slab follows in a stretched-out, bookish serif, its wire-like strokes making a longer passage move at a dignified, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-luxurious-roman-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads in an editorial, traditional serif voice, with generous letterspace and rings of o that hold a constant wall. And a longer passage in it moves steadily, while Luxurious Roman above supplies the bolder, open-terminal display.
